steps: call mcp__repo__git_log (it is bounded) when the session has it
open one commit with mcp__repo__git_show, never the whole log
Grep the lockfile for the package name with -n
Read only those lines with offset and limit
for the installed version call mcp__dev__dev_deps instead
use Glob with one pattern for the files you need
narrow to the folder you care about before listing
